2027-01-07.title: First Thursday of Denha
2027-01-07.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: A great prophet has risen among us
2027-01-07.verse: Fear seized all of them; and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has risen among us!” and “God has looked favorably on his people!”
theo: The day after Denha the Church goes on contemplating what God has revealed. St Paul speaks of a wisdom that is “not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age”, but “God's wisdom, secret and hidden, which God decreed before the ages for our glory.” The powerful did not grasp it; “if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.” Now it has been opened to us. “What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the human heart conceived, what God has prepared for those who love him”, God has revealed “through the Spirit; for the Spirit searches everything, even the depths of God.”

In the Gospel this hidden wisdom shows its face. At the gate of Nain Jesus meets a funeral: a widow is burying “his mother's only son”. No one asks him for anything. Luke says simply that the Lord saw her and “had compassion for her”. He tells her not to weep, touches the bier and commands: “Young man, I say to you, rise!” Then “Jesus gave him to his mother”, the very gesture of Elijah at Zarephath. The crowd cries out: “A great prophet has risen among us!” and “God has looked favorably on his people!” In the season of Denha this is what manifestation means: the wisdom of God revealed as a compassion that stops at our funerals and gives life.
outline: Ask: where have you seen God's wisdom take the form of compassion?
Not the wisdom of this age.

live: Read one page of the Gospel slowly today and ask the Spirit to show you its depth.
Visit or call someone who is grieving this week.
2027-01-07.prayer: Lord Jesus, wisdom of God made visible, you stopped at the gate of Nain and gave a widow back her son. Open my eyes by your Spirit to what God has prepared for those who love him, and give me your compassion for those who weep. Amen.
altar: In the Holy Qurbana the Lord of glory, whom the rulers of this age crucified, comes to us risen. He who said to the young man, rise, gives us the bread of eternal life.

quick: God's wisdom is hidden from the proud and revealed by the Spirit.
What God has prepared for those who love him is beyond imagining.
At Nain Jesus had compassion and raised the widow's son.
2027-01-07.action: Visit or call someone who is grieving this week.
2027-01-07.question: Do I let God's compassion stop me on my way?

family.explain: Jesus met a mother who was crying because her only son had died. Jesus felt sorry for her and said: do not cry. He touched the stretcher and said: young man, get up! The young man sat up, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
family.intention: We pray for families who are sad because someone they love has died.
family.ask: Ask: “How can we comfort someone who is sad?”

illus: A parish priest near Thodupuzha was on his way to an important meeting when he passed a small house with a crowd outside: a young father had died suddenly. He stopped, prayed with the widow and stayed for an hour. He missed the meeting. Years later the widow's son, by then a priest himself, said that hour was when he first understood who Jesus is.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you had compassion on the widow of Nain. Come among us now with your wisdom and your mercy. Amen.
share: God's wisdom, secret and hidden (1 Corinthians 2:7). Where do I look for wisdom: in the world or in God?
What God has prepared for those who love him (1 Corinthians 2:9). What do I hope for from God?
When the Lord saw her, he had compassion for her (Luke 7:13). Whose tears do I see?
interc: For the Church, that she may proclaim the wisdom of the Cross.
For widows and for mothers who have lost children.
For the dying and the dead, that they may rise with Christ.
For those who seek wisdom in the wrong places.
For our group, that we may share Christ's compassion.
pm.close: Father, your wisdom was hidden from the rulers of this age and revealed in your Son. Fill us with his compassion, and raise us with him to eternal life. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, on the day after Denha St Paul speaks of a wisdom that is not of this age. God's wisdom, secret and hidden, was decreed before the ages for our glory (1 Corinthians 2:7). The rulers of this age did not understand it; if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

This wisdom cannot be reached by cleverness. What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the human heart conceived, God has prepared for those who love him, and he has revealed it to us through the Spirit (1 Corinthians 2:9–10).

In the Gospel we see that wisdom with a human face. At the gate of Nain a widow follows the body of her only son. Nobody asks Jesus for help. He sees her, has compassion for her, and says: do not weep. He touches the bier and says: young man, I say to you, rise! And he gives him back to his mother (Luke 7:13–15).

The people cry out: a great prophet has risen among us; God has looked favourably on his people (Luke 7:16). This is the manifestation of Denha: God's wisdom is a compassion that stops at our funerals and gives life. Let us ask for it, and let us stop for those who weep. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus saw a mother crying because her son had died. He felt sorry for her and brought her son back to life! Jesus cares when we are sad. Let us care for sad people too.

intro: Theme: “A great prophet has risen among us!”
The hidden wisdom of God, revealed in compassion.

sub: Not the wisdom of this age.
q: For the LORD gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding;
But we speak God's wisdom, secret and hidden, which God decreed before the ages for our glory.
points.apply: Ask the Holy Spirit for wisdom each time you open the Scriptures.

sub: Prepared for those who love him.
q: From ages past no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who works for those who wait for him.
But, as it is written, “What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the human heart conceived, what God has prepared for those who love him”
points.apply: Make an act of love for God each morning this week.

sub: He gives him to his mother.
q: Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper chamber into the house, and gave him to his mother; then Elijah said, “See, your son is alive.”
When the Lord saw her, he had compassion for her and said to her, “Do not weep.”
points.apply: Visit or call someone who is grieving.

concl: God's wisdom is not cold knowledge but compassion that gives life.
In Denha, God has looked favourably on his people.
